title: Plan a Dataverse solution
subtitle: Move from data model to relationships, automation and access design.

steps.title: List the business data needed
steps.evidence: List required business data, group it into focused tables and choose suitable column types before building the app.

steps.title: Group data into tables and columns
steps.evidence: group it into focused tables and choose suitable column types before building the app.

steps.title: Map record relationships
steps.evidence: Map how records connect before selecting one-to-many or many-to-many relationships, reducing repeated data.

steps.title: Plan automation and access
steps.evidence: The guidance recommends planning the data model first, using business rules, Power Fx formulas and workflows for clear process needs, and defining roles and permissions as part of solution design.
